messages:
From: Sana Patel <sana@stacker.ai>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T15:08:00-07:00
Subject: Interested after self-serve signup — quick demo?

Hi Jordan,

We signed up for Redwood’s free tier earlier this week while testing against our in-house reranking pipeline. Early results look promising and we’d like to explore a short pilot to validate latency and cost at production scale. Quick background: we’re Stacker.ai — building conversational shopping for SMB retail sites. Typical traffic profile: ~350k user messages/month, peak bursts up to 8k q/hr. Average user message + context ~220 tokens; expected candidate generations ~3 per request.

Top asks before we book a demo:
- Rough latency SLOs you can meet for 95th pct under burst;
- Any examples of customers with similar monthly volume;
- Security: SOC 2 / data retention / VPC options;
- Pilot timeline: we’d like to run a 4–6 week pilot starting in Oct.

Can you do a 30-min demo next week? I attached a small export (stacker_prod_metrics.csv) that shows our traffic curve.

Thanks,
Sana
Chief Product Officer | Stacker.ai
attachments: stacker_prod_metrics.csv

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Sana Patel <sana@stacker.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2026-09-10T16:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Interested after self-serve signup — quick demo?

Hi Sana — great to hear you kicked the tires on the self-serve flow, glad it looked promising. Short answers up front and then a couple of quick qual questions so we tailor the demo: 

- 95th-pct latency: on hosted Redwood we typically hit ~120–250ms per token at similar burst patterns depending on model + batching; for Dedicated we can tighten that substantially with reserved capacity.
- Similar customers: a few commerce customers run 200–500k messages / mo in pilot; I can share anonymized profiles in the call.
- Security: Redwood is SOC 2 Type II; we offer VPC/private deployments and customer-managed KMS for Private plans — we’ll include our security packet.

A few quick clarifying questions so we don’t waste your time on the demo:
1) Is inference synchronous (real-time chat) or do you have a delayed/async pipeline for reranking?
2) Are you planning to call our hosted API or consider Dedicated/Private for the pilot?
3) Do you have a sample payload (anonymized) that shows average context + candidate size?

Proposed 30-min slots (PT):
- Tue Sep 14: 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed Sep 15: 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu Sep 16: 08:30–09:00 PT

I’ve looped in Ben (solutions engineer) and Marissa (CS) — they’ll join the call to answer throughput/infra and pilot onboarding questions. If you confirm a slot, we’ll send a calendar invite + short pre-demo checklist.

Best,
Jordan Blake
Enterprise SDR | Redwood Inference
